about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack for the demonic 2D metroidvania, "Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark." The OST includes 23 background tracks as well as a full version of the opening song, "Maid in Nightmares", sung by the stars Kirika and Masha. It comes complete with images of the included booklet with lyrics and full credits.

File Format: mp3 (256kbps)
